<a id="abiss-data"></a>
### ABISS benchmark design

**dataset** · [Official resource](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23340)

Describes generation of ambiguous/unanswerable questions and a multi-turn environment with style-aware simulated users.

**Protocol / role:** Dynamic user simulation and classification/SQL-resolution evaluation over ABISS-BIRD and ABISS-Spider.

**Availability:** Paper-described benchmark; linked author repository says COMING SOON and has no data or implementation visible.

**License / access:** Dataset license unverified; placeholder repository's MIT file does not establish dataset terms.

**Related papers:** [ABISS: Evaluating Text-to-SQL Systems Through Agent Interaction](../papers/README.md#abiss)

**Sources:** [Source 1](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.23340) · [Source 2](https://github.com/giosullutrone/ABISS-Evaluating-Text-to-SQL-Systems-Through-Agent-Interaction)
**Content checked:** 2026-10-22.

<a id="ambiqt-data"></a>
### AmbiQT

**dataset** · [Official resource](https://github.com/tomartushar/AmbiQT/tree/master/benchmark)

Questions paired with two plausible SQL queries arising from lexical or structural ambiguity.

**Protocol / role:** Tests coverage of alternative SQL interpretations, rather than live clarification quality.

**Availability:** Benchmark JSON, category generators/evaluators, and database-content archive visible; not executed.

**License / access:** Repository declares MIT; source Spider data terms remain relevant.

**Related papers:** [Benchmarking and Improving Text-to-SQL Generation under Ambiguity](../papers/README.md#ambiqt)

**Sources:** [Source 1](https://github.com/tomartushar/AmbiQT/tree/master/benchmark) · [Source 2](https://github.com/tomartushar/AmbiQT) · [Source 3](https://aclanthology.org/2023.emnlp-main.436/)
**Content checked:** 2026-10-22.

<a id="ambival-data"></a>
### AmbiVal

**dataset** · [Official resource](https://huggingface.co/datasets/griffith-bigdata/ambival)

Author-linked resource for schema and value ambiguity in the RAQS-SQL work.

**Protocol / role:** Ambiguous-query and schema/value-context evaluation; use the paper and associated files to establish the intended splits.

**Availability:** Public files/preview visible; README is empty and the viewer reports a schema mismatch; no download or execution attempted.

**License / access:** Hugging Face metadata declares MIT; upstream datasets may impose additional terms.

**Related papers:** [RAQS-SQL: Schema and Value Ambiguity Resolution in Text-to-SQL](../papers/README.md#raqs-sql)

**Sources:** [Source 1](https://huggingface.co/datasets/griffith-bigdata/ambival) · [Source 2](https://huggingface.co/collections/griffith-bigdata/raqs-sql) · [Source 3](https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/abstract/document/11720244)
**Content checked:** 2026-10-22.

<a id="ambrosia-data"></a>
### AMBROSIA

**dataset** · [Official resource](https://ambrosia-benchmark.github.io/)

Ambiguous requests with interpretations and SQL for scope, attachment, and vagueness cases.

**Protocol / role:** Multiple valid interpretations remain possible even with database context; evaluate coverage rather than a single chosen answer.

**Availability:** Author-controlled download; project asks that data not be mirrored to GitHub or Hugging Face.

**License / access:** Dataset license not verified; respect the author's download and redistribution conditions.

**Related papers:** [AMBROSIA: A Benchmark for Parsing Ambiguous Questions into Database Queries](../papers/README.md#ambrosia)

**Sources:** [Source 1](https://ambrosia-benchmark.github.io/) · [Source 2](https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.19073)
**Content checked:** 2026-10-22.

<a id="arcs-data"></a>
### ARCS benchmark design

**dataset** · [Official resource](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09396)

Ambiguous database questions with annotated ambiguity points, interpretations, and SQL queries.

**Protocol / role:** Structured disambiguation through constrained interactions rather than unrestricted clarification dialogue.

**Availability:** Paper-described benchmark; dataset release not verified in this pass.

**License / access:** License not verified; consult the resource and any upstream data terms before reuse.

**Related papers:** [ARCS: Towards Precise Text-to-SQL via Structured Disambiguation](../papers/README.md#arcs)

**Sources:** [Source 1](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09396)
**Content checked:** 2026-10-22.

<a id="bird-interact-data"></a>
### BIRD-Interact Full, Lite, and Mini

**dataset** · [Official resource](https://huggingface.co/datasets/birdsql/bird-interact-full)

Interactive SQL tasks with ambiguity annotations, follow-ups, database environments, and user simulation.

**Protocol / role:** Full/Lite PostgreSQL and Mini SQLite are distinct variants; c-Interact and a-Interact differ in who controls interaction.

**Availability:** Public task cards/files verified; evaluator ground truth and some materials follow the authors' access procedure.

**License / access:** CC BY-SA 4.0 data; MIT code.

**Related papers:** [BIRD-INTERACT: Re-imagining Text-to-SQL Evaluation for Large Language Models via Lens of Dynamic Interactions](../papers/README.md#bird-interact)

**Sources:** [Source 1](https://huggingface.co/datasets/birdsql/bird-interact-full) · [Source 2](https://bird-interact.github.io/) · [Source 3](https://github.com/bird-bench/BIRD-Interact)
**Content checked:** 2026-10-22.

<a id="cosql-data"></a>
### CoSQL

**dataset** · [Official resource](https://yale-lily.github.io/cosql)

Wizard-of-Oz conversations with SQL answers, clarifications, and unanswerable or unrelated questions.

<a id="ehrsql-data"></a>
### EHRSQL

**dataset** · [Official resource](https://github.com/glee4810/EHRSQL)

Clinical database questions spanning SQL generation, temporal expressions, and abstention.

**Protocol / role:** MIMIC-III/eICU evaluation with processed database values; intended for query evaluation, not clinical analysis.

**Availability:** Annotation files and processed-database download links visible; building from original data requires PhysioNet credentialed access.

**License / access:** Annotation repository declares CC BY 4.0; original EHR databases have separate access and use terms.

**Related papers:** [EHRSQL: A Practical Text-to-SQL Benchmark for Electronic Health Records](../papers/README.md#ehrsql)

**Sources:** [Source 1](https://github.com/glee4810/EHRSQL) · [Source 2](https://arxiv.org/abs/2301.07695)
**Content checked:** 2026-10-22.

<a id="ehrsql-2024-data"></a>
### EHRSQL 2024 shared-task data

**dataset** · [Official resource](https://github.com/glee4810/ehrsql-2024)

Answerable and unanswerable MIMIC-IV demo questions with reliability-oriented shared-task scoring.

**Protocol / role:** Models may answer or abstain; distinguish incorrect SQL from inability to answer the question.

**Availability:** Public annotations, ingestion/scoring scripts, and MIMIC-IV demo preprocessing instructions visible; not executed.

**License / access:** Repository: CC BY 4.0. Referenced MIMIC-IV demo: Open Database License 1.0.

**Related papers:** [Overview of the EHRSQL 2024 Shared Task on Reliable Text-to-SQL Modeling on Electronic Health Records](../papers/README.md#ehrsql-2024)

**Sources:** [Source 1](https://github.com/glee4810/ehrsql-2024) · [Source 2](https://aclanthology.org/2024.clinicalnlp-1.62/)
**Content checked:** 2026-10-22.

<a id="tide-bench-data"></a>
### TIDE-Bench benchmark design

**dataset** · [Official resource](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29543)

Conversation tasks with dependent clarification chains and user revisions that retract earlier commitments.

**Protocol / role:** Chain identification and intent-drift recognition/resolution metrics complement execution accuracy.

**Availability:** Paper-described benchmark; linked repository contains only README, LICENSE, and .gitattributes, so downloadable data are unverified.

**License / access:** Dataset license unverified; placeholder repository MIT does not establish released dataset terms.

**Related papers:** [Evaluating LLMs on Conversational Text-to-SQL under Chain Ambiguity and Intent Drift](../papers/README.md#tide-bench)

**Sources:** [Source 1](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.29543) · [Source 2](https://github.com/Rcrossmeister/TIDE-Bench)
**Content checked:** 2026-10-22.
